# When Pizza Night Meets Game Night: Domino's is Fueling Your Battle in Minecraft Dungeons II


Published: October 27, 2026


[Share](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fmedia.dominos.com%2Fstories%2F/stories/when-pizza-night-meets-game-night-dominos-is-fueling-your-battle-in-minecraft-dungeons-ii/%2F&src=sdkpreparse)


[Tweet](https://twitter.com/share?ref_src=twsrc%5Etfw)


To celebrate the launch of Minecraft Dungeons II, Domino's is serving up exclusive experiences that bring players and pizza lovers together for the ultimate game night.


There are few combinations more natural than pizza and gaming. Now, Domino’s is taking that pairing beyond the dinner table and into the game itself.


Beginning Oct. 26, 2026,[Domino’s and Minecraft Dungeons II are teaming up](https://www.dominos.com/minecraft-dungeons-ii?ref=media.dominos.com) to create a new kind of game night, complete with collectible pizza boxes, exclusive in-game items, a chance to score the game and an interactive Domino’s Tracker® experience.


At the center of it all is the Domino™, Domino’s new made-for-one pizza. Its distinct block shape and gaming-friendly format created a natural connection to the Minecraft Dungeons II action-packed universe.


“When we launched the Domino, we saw an opportunity to think beyond the pizza itself and create experiences that surprise and delight customers,” said Kate Trumbull, Domino’s executive vice president and chief marketing officer. “Minecraft Dungeons II is all about teaming up with friends for epic adventures, and the Domino is built for those same moments.”


**Six Boxes. Three In-Game Items. A Whole New Adventure.**


The experience starts before players even open the game.


Customers who purchase a Domino will receive one of six collectible Minecraft Dungeons II-themed boxes featuring characters including Corrupted Creeper, Prime Enchanter, Valorie, Zombie, Pig and Creeper, while supplies last.


For Domino’s Rewards members, the experience stretches into the action. Each qualifying online Domino purchase can unlock one of three exclusive in-game items, randomly awarded: a Domino’s Skin, Domino’s Slice Slayer Cape or the Domino’s Cheesy Cube Pet.* The latter has a distinction of its own: it is the first co-branded partnership pet to appear in Minecraft Dungeons II.


And then there’s the ultimate game-night prize: the game itself.


From Oct. 26-Nov. 4, 2026, Domino’s is giving away 2,000 Minecraft Dungeons II digital game codes each day, for a total of 20,000. Customers who purchase a Domino can submit their proof of purchase for the chance to receive the Standard Edition of the game for PC or Xbox series (a $29.99 value).**


Starting on Oct. 26, 2026, customers who order a Domino – Domino’s new made-for-one pizza – can collect six boxes, each featuring a different Minecraft Dungeons II character.


**Even Domino’s Tracker® Is Getting in on the Action**


The adventure won’t stop once customers place their pizza order.


Domino’s is also bringing Minecraft Dungeons II to its iconic Domino’s Tracker with a custom, interactive themed experience for customers who order a Domino. More details are coming soon!


“With its block shape, playful spirit and perfect-for-gaming format, the Domino felt right at home in the Minecraft Dungeons II universe,” Trumbull said. “Together, we're turning every purchase into an adventure, giving fans exclusive content, collectible items, and a chance to bring their love of pizza and gaming together.”


**A Collaboration That Goes Around the World**


The collaboration reaches well beyond the U.S.


Domino’s and Minecraft Dungeons II are rolling out experiences across 19 additional markets, including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, Spain and others. Specific products, experiences and timing will vary by country.


It’s a fittingly big footprint for a gaming franchise whose signature building blocks are recognized around the globe. Minecraft is the best-selling video game of all time, with players in every country and territory around the world.


For Domino’s, it’s another way to make a familiar occasion, ordering pizza and settling in for game night, a little more fun.


And this time, the adventure begins with a box.
